posts.body_hr: Tema: InterCapital BET-TRN UCITS ETF (7BET). Činjenice (tečajnica ZSE 7. 8. 2026.; factsheet izdavatelja za srpanj 2026., objavljen 3. 8.): 1) Pasivni dionički ETF koji replicira BET-TRN, total-return indeks vodećih dionica Burze u Bukureštu (Rumunjska); dividende se reinvestiraju. 2) Zadnja cijena na ZSE 30,75 € (7. 8.); neto imovina fonda 52,4 mil. €; na ZSE uvršten 26. 5. 2023. 3) Ukupni godišnji trošak (TER) 0,84 %. 4) Prinos fonda u zadnjih godinu dana +77,3 %, indeksa +78,9 % — razlika je trošak i tehnika replikacije. 5) Najveće pozicije (srpanj 2026.): Banca Transilvania 18,5 %, OMV Petrom 15,7 %, Societatea Nationala de Gaze 14,4 %, Hidroelectrica 12,0 %. 6) Likvidnost na ZSE: trgovano 220 od 250 radnih dana u zadnjih godinu dana. 7) Pokazatelji portfelja: P/E 15,5; dividendni prinos sastavnica 2,8 % (reinvestira se).
posts.body_en: Topic: InterCapital BET-TRN UCITS ETF (7BET). Facts (ZSE price list 7 Aug 2026; issuer factsheet for July 2026, published 3 Aug): 1) A passive equity ETF replicating BET-TRN, the total-return index of leading Bucharest Stock Exchange (Romania) stocks; dividends are reinvested. 2) Last ZSE price EUR 30.75 (7 Aug); fund net assets EUR 52.4M; listed on the ZSE since 26 May 2023. 3) Total expense ratio (TER) 0.84% a year. 4) Fund return over the past year +77.3%, the index +78.9% — the difference is cost and replication technique. 5) Largest positions (July 2026): Banca Transilvania 18.5%, OMV Petrom 15.7%, Societatea Nationala de Gaze 14.4%, Hidroelectrica 12.0%. 6) ZSE liquidity: traded on 220 of 250 working days over the past year. 7) Portfolio indicators: P/E 15.5; constituent dividend yield 2.8% (reinvested).
